title: 生成 TS Client
implementation: tools/codegen parses the OpenAPI contract and generates api-client.ts; HTTP verbs, /api/v1 paths, and path parameter encoding come from the generated client
Generated operations include Feed GET/PUT and read-only test command paths
Request methods support generic response types for Dashboard, Rules, Sites, Feeds, Commands, and History callers
RequestOptions supports controlled headers so If-Match, Idempotency-Key, and CSRF headers are transported without exposing secrets
decodeError follows error_codes.yaml mapping; unknown codes normalize to INTERNAL_ERROR; cursor and stream helpers remain transport-only
codegen drift and client regression tests cover Feed update path, headers, verbs, encoded parameters, errors, and cursor handling

blocker: Local-only generated client coverage is complete for the current contract. Deep schema response types, full SSE client behavior, and real external service workflows remain future work.
